items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: My other brother and sister, George and Cleora, they were born in Texas.

ctx.x: I was the first child born in Oklahoma. My other brother and sister, George and Cleora, they were born in Texas. And that had a great effect on my life, as I later analyzed it. I don't know what I was doing, analyzing things that young. But I went to a grade school...
Well, before you go into grade school, Foots, I want to know your father's name and your mother's name.
